> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.1.0 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**
>
> At publication time, Obsidian 1.13 is available only as a Catalyst early-access (beta) release. Catalyst access and **Receive early access versions** are therefore currently required to use this release.

See [Obsidian Catalyst](https://obsidian.md/help/catalyst) and the [Obsidian 1.13.0 changelog](https://obsidian.md/changelog/2026-05-28-desktop-v1.13.0/) for details.
